<function name="GetScrollStartIndexes" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the vertical and horizontal start indexes of a <page>TextEntry</page>'s visible text. This is useful when the panel is scrolled.
	</description>
	<added>2023.10.04</added>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="horizontalIndex" type="number">The horizontal start index. (characters)</ret>
		<ret name="verticalIndex" type="number">The vertical start index. (lines)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
